claim: Annual cyber awareness training is required for system access per DOD 8500.01E.
quote: Ensure cybersecurity awareness indoctrination and annual refresher training is conducted and documented down to the user level
fix: Cite MCO 5239.2B, not DoDI 8500.01.

claim: No waivers of cyber training under DOD 8500.01E. The Marine completes training before access continues.
quote: No waiver prohibition found.
fix: Cite a source or remove the no-waiver line.

claim: Closure of a Marine returning within 90 days: reactivation requires a fresh access request per MCO 5239.2B.
quote: No 90-day return rule found.
fix: MCO 5239.2B has no 90-day return rule. PAA 02-26 para 4.d.3 requires a new request after disablement.

claim: From 21 September 2026 the fresh MCTFS request routes through DoD E-ICAM per PAA 02-26.
quote: Beginning 21 September 2026, new requests to create, modify, or revoke MCTFS end user access must be submitted through E-ICAM.

claim: The S-1 officer suspends a certifier who signed without the privileged access agreement per MCO 5239.2B.
quote: Certifying Officer authority must be terminated utilizing the DD Form 577.
fix: Termination authority rests with the appointing CO or PAC Director via DD 577, not the S-1 officer.

claim: Internal Control Annual Statement required under DoDI 5010.40.
quote: Establishes and owns an RMIC program improvement structure for ICOR-FR and ICOR- FS
fix: Statement of assurance is a Component SOA at 4.7. The title is now "DoD Enterprise Risk Management and Risk Management and Internal Control Program". Update line 22.

claim: NAVMC 3500.3E T-R event 0111-PERA-2002 covers admin audit processes.
quote: The audit tools provided by the MCTFS include the BIR, BTR, LES, RED, ICR, DMR, Disbursing Reports, IMPROMPTU and MCTFS Accuracy Survey.
fix: Event reviews MCTFS report audits. It does not cover account or access reviews.

claim: MISSO supports closure requests per MCO 5000.14D enclosure 6.
quote: Establishing unit access to manpower information systems.
fix: Encl 6 lists support and unit access. It names no closure request process.
